name: daily-reconciliation
title: Daily reconciliation
subtitle: Movements, proposed matches and unresolved items

sections.title: Coverage by account
sections.sql: select account,currency,transactions,unmatched,proposed,approved,difference_cents from account_coverage order by account
sections.note: Movement totals are not closing balances. No netting across currencies.

sections.title: Items needing attention
sections.sql: select account,reference,currency,amount_cents,age_days,owner,issue from attention_queue order by age_days desc

sections.title: Owner workload
sections.sql: select * from owner_backlog order by owner,currency
sections.note: Gross values count both sides. They are workload exposure, not a loss estimate.

sections.title: Evidence and review findings
sections.sql: select rule,account,finding from compliance_findings order by rule,account
sections.note: Run the compliance command to check archived source-file hashes too.

sections.title: Proposed and approved groups
sections.sql: select a.name account,m.status,m.reason,m.proposed_by,m.approved_by from matches m join accounts a on a.id=m.account_id order by m.created_at
